name: claude-relais
description: Claude Code plugins to cut token usage and check what Claude says.

plugins.name: relais
plugins.description: Context gauge + /relais handoff + automatic resume after /clear: stop re-reading huge conversations on every action. 100% local.

plugins.name: avocat
plugins.description: Devil's advocate mode: while switched on, an independent read-only agent tries to refute every Claude answer (facts, code, actions) before it is final. /avocat on|off or the relais dashboard. 100% local.
